title: Polatuzumab Vedotin Plus Rituximab, Gemcitabine, and Oxaliplatin in Relapsed or Refractory Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma: Results From the Phase III, Randomized POLARGO Trial
observations_or_assays: IRC-assessed overall response rate at end of treatment
time_scope: The primary/final randomized-cohort analysis; ORR at the article-defined end of treatment.
excluded: Nonrandomized safety run-in, CR-only rate and other response categories
Subgroup/sensitivity analyses, other survival landmarks and safety
population_or_material: Transplant-ineligible R/R DLBCL patients in the randomized POLARGO ITT efficacy population.
requested_items: Main efficacy Table 2 OS/PFS medians and primary HRs; IRC end-of-treatment ORR counts/proportions and explicitly reported between-arm rate difference. Exclude landmark survival rates and CR-only response.
